It does not modify files outside of systemd's service management scope or access sensitive user data. The post-install message is purely informational and guides the user on how to start the user service manually if needed. This behavior aligns with standard packaging practices for systemd-based services in Arch Linux and poses no supply-chain risk.

There are no signs of obfuscated code, suspicious network activity, or unauthorized file operations.
